title.narrative: System Strengthening - EMIS - EMIS that provides disaggregated data, including income/assets, disability and school physical environment - score (1-4), see guidance (22-01-L3-38), Number
System Strengthening - Learning assessment - Existence of a national/system-level large scale assessment, including for early grades - score (1-4), see guidance, Number

System Strengthening - Education sector planning - Existence of national strategies to address inequities in education access, participation and retention - score (1-4), see guidance (22-01-L3-27), Text
System Strengthening - Emergency preparedness - Availability of a risk reduction strategy within the Education Sector Plan/Policy, Number
